strings.app.title: Battery Monitor
strings.app.subtitle: Real-Time Battery Dashboard
strings.rt.title: Real-Time Monitor
strings.hist.title: Charge History
strings.hist.empty_hint: Charge your Mac then tap Refresh
strings.proc.title: Power-Hungry Processes
strings.tip.charge_power: Real-time power (W) flowing into or out of the battery. Positive = charging, negative = discharging.
strings.tip.adapter: Rated wattage of the connected power adapter. 0W means no adapter detected.
strings.tip.temperature: Current battery cell temperature. Normal range: 20–35°C. Above 40°C may throttle performance.
strings.tip.cycles: Total charge cycles consumed. Apple rates batteries for ~1000 cycles before health drops below 80%.
strings.tip.health: Current max capacity vs. original design capacity. 100% = brand new. Below 80% = consider replacement.
strings.tip.condition: System-assessed battery condition based on health metrics and cycle count.
strings.tip.voltage: Battery terminal voltage. Typical range: 10–13V for MacBook batteries.
strings.tip.amperage: Charge/discharge current in milliamps. Positive = charging, negative = discharging.
strings.tip.power: Instantaneous power = |Current| × Voltage. Shows real-time energy flow.
strings.tip.percent: Current state of charge as percentage of usable capacity.
strings.tip.charge_rate: How many percent the battery gains per hour. Higher = faster charging.
strings.tip.cpu: CPU usage percentage of this process. Higher CPU = more power draw.
